title: Route failed current-head critical gates to one durable existing PR owner instead of treating completed red runs as coverage
root_cause: Verified existing five-minute Required Gate Watchdog checks only for absence of a Required run; a completed failed run is considered present, with no owner signal. Prior website mobile CLS 0.168 > 0.100 was detected on #4656 without auto handoff to canonical website owner #4651.
impact: Failed Required / CodeQL outcomes can persist unnoticed by owner agents; repeated source-test retries or duplicate PRs risk queue pressure and obscured real layout defects.
failed_approaches: Treating any completed Required test as successful coverage
Blind rerun-failed-jobs on no-job CodeQL startup_failure (GitHub HTTP 403)
Creating a parallel workflow/scheduler or new same-file PR
Waiving browser CLS 0.100 gate to force green
First actual postmerge watchdog invocation stopped at HTTP 403 PR-owner comment and prevented following PR recoveries.
fix: Existing Required Gate Watchdog now classifies latest exact-head Required and CodeQL, emits deduplicated structured PR owner recovery notes with immutable failing job refs and no blind retry, while keeping missing-run dispatch unchanged. Follow-up: explicitly request pull-requests:write, classify precise 401/403 only at owner comment endpoint, cap denied signal attempts, keep unrelated missing-Required dispatch active, and fail the run visibly on denied notification.
prevention_rule: A current-head failed critical gate must remain RECOVERY_REQUIRED until the original writer fixes proven source and verifies exact-head Required, CodeQL and deployment. Detect one fail signal per immutable gate/head in the existing five-minute watchdog; never create duplicate recovery writer or scheduler; preserve CLS<=0.100, tenancy, security and all real gates. Never terminate the entire watchdog on one denied owner PR comment before unrelated safe missing-gate dispatch; denied notification remains RED and auditable.

evidence.observed_auth_denial: GitHub Actions GITHUB_TOKEN advertised issues:write but only pull-requests:read; POST /issues/4656/comments returned 403. Missing Required dispatch for #4662 had succeeded first.

outcome: CANDIDATE owner signal routing, not arbitrary autonomous code repair or live deployment

shadow: Failed Required and CodeQL signal should route to only the original writer once per immutable head
negative_canary: Queued and in_progress must not be retried
Failed source test must not be marked green or bypassed
Duplicate signal on same head must not create second comment
Sitewide phone CLS 0.168 > 0.100 must remain a failing gate
